BOX2D 2.1.2 - ALTERED SOURCE VERSION

This vendored Box2D source tree is an altered source version derived from a
historical Box2D 2.1.2 baseline.

It contains or is built with compatibility changes selected for this
Angry Birds ARM64 reconstruction and must not be represented as the original,
unmodified Box2D distribution.
